speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancoast Syndrome (Superior Sulcus Tumor) with Right Brachial Plexopathy.

The combination of a 55-year-old male bodybuilder presenting with progressive right arm weakness, burning pain, and decreased sensation, alongside significant unexplained weight loss, strongly suggests a malignancy in the lung apex compressing the brachial plexus. His history of heavy smoking is a major risk factor for this presentation.
